Consultation CTA

When you reach us by QR code or email, please share the details below so we can match the right modules, deployment mode, and delivery scope.

ItemWhat to describe
Vessel type and operationVessel category, length and tonnage, and whether the operation is deep-sea, coastal, or inland waterway.
Navigation watersMain routes, port approaches, inland waterway coverage, and any official notices that must be covered for specific waters.
Chart dataData formats (S-57 / S-63 / S-101), data source and update cycle, and any encryption or licensing constraints.
Warning requirementsWarning types to cover (shoals, obstructions, speed-limit zones, prohibited areas, bridge clearance, etc.) and the preferred alerting method.
Deployment environmentOnboard or shore-side deployment, operating system and hardware, and whether offline operation or platform adaptation is required.
Integration needsExisting navigation or information systems, interface protocols (NMEA, WebSocket, etc.), and the planned integration approach.

After receiving your details, we reply by email or WeCom and arrange a product demo and solution discussion.
